breakdown.description: Ideal-gas normal-shock relations are applied to liquid water without a valid equation of state/model.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains 'water' as the working fluid instead of correcting it to 'air.' Ideal-gas normal-shock relations with γ=1.4 are applicable to air, not liquid water. The agent did not flag or fix this inconsistency and instead proceeded to add assumptions (T=288 K, P=101325 Pa) that would be appropriate for air but not for water, compounding the error.
